description: This file defines Slack approval capabilities and resolvers for an approval system, including functions for handling Slack-specific approval requests, target resolution, and integration with external SDKs.

methods.name: extractSlackSessionKind
methods.description: Extracts the session kind ('direct', 'channel', 'group') from a session key string.

methods.name: normalizeComparableTarget
methods.description: Normalizes a string target for comparison by trimming and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: normalizeSlackThreadMatchKey
methods.description: Normalizes Slack thread IDs by trimming and extracting leading epoch if present.

methods.name: resolveTurnSourceSlackOriginTarget
methods.description: Resolves the Slack origin target from an approval request, parsing Slack target info.

methods.name: resolveSessionSlackOriginTarget
methods.description: Converts session target info into a SlackOriginTarget object.

methods.name: slackTargetsMatch
methods.description: Checks if two SlackOriginTarget objects match based on 'to' and 'threadId'.
